Create your 14-day free trial account in the EchoDesk app

There is no web signup form yet. Open the EchoDesk app on your phone or Mac, then tap Create account on the first screen.

On iPhone

Run the installed app build, or from the repo: cd mobile && ./run_prod.sh <device-id> release

On Mac (desktop app)

From the repo: cd mobile && ./run_prod.sh macos profile — then use Create account / Log in on the welcome screen.

Confirm your email

After signup, confirm from the email link. You should return to the app (or open the app and log in with the same email).
